method: Live presenter view of independently authored controls; automatic timings disabled temporarily and restored afterward. Control slides use coordinate gradients and striped shapes rather than content from the audited deck.

observations.evidence: Leaving slide remains visible immediately after P; both full slide images blend at approximately four seconds; slide 1 becomes current after the reverse fade completes. The destination is authored None.
Slide 3 fades into slide 2 without spatial translation. This uses the arriving slide's Fade, rather than the leaving slide's Push.

presetControl.observation: Previous from slide 2 reverses its ten-second double curl into slide 1 even though slide 1 is authored None. The reverse deformation is visible midway through the transition.
presetControl.directJumpObservation: Slide 1 appears immediately. A direct jump differs from Previous to the same destination. This Home check uses the double-curl control.

scope: This evidence establishes transition ownership and navigation intent. It does not validate the application's curl geometry, other effect trajectories, or timing for every reference application version.
